title: Fix rig bone selection pivots and rename body pelvis root
description:
Fix SceneView rig-bone manipulation so a selected generated bone has an explicit, correct manipulation pivot, and keep the compact body root semantic name as body_root. Unity 6.5 does not permit assignment to Tools.handlePosition. The branch now includes a dedicated editor rotation tool using Handles.RotationHandle at the selected bone's actual Transform.position. It is intentionally editor-only and does not mutate global PivotMode. The normal Unity Rotate tool remains a separate fallback until live Unity verification confirms the custom tool is the intended interaction path.

Implementation requirements: trace BoneSnapshot.Position through SkeletonInferrer/SkeletonSnapshot/CreatureRig and do not mask a runtime placement bug with editor code; generated body/neck/limb transforms must retain their authoritative world-space positions; explicit rig-bone selection must be single-object; the custom rotation handle must be positioned from the selected bone transform, respect Tools.pivotRotation Local/Global orientation, support Undo, and leave ordinary Unity objects unaffected; retain body_root naming consistently.

Adversarial review must challenge: Unity 6 EditorTool API availability, editor-tool activation semantics, Selection.objects versus active object, Center/Pivot behavior, world versus local rotation, parent-child Transform semantics, multiple open SceneViews/rigs, interaction with the existing RigDebugView handles, undo/redo, and whether the custom handle is accidentally editing world rotation when the user expects local rotation.

Acceptance: selected rig bone has a dedicated rotation handle exactly at its Transform.position; local/global axis orientation matches Tools.pivotRotation; rotating one bone changes only the intended Transform and its hierarchy descendants; Undo restores the prior transform; normal Unity selections remain unaffected; no Tools.handlePosition assignment remains; body_root naming is complete; focused editor tests/build pass; live Unity SceneView verification confirms no eye/head pivot aliasing.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 4 USER COMPILATION REPRO. Unity 6.5 reports CS0200: Tools.handlePosition is read-only. The prior implementation attempted to assign this property, so that approach is invalid for the target Unity API.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 4 REPAIR. Removed the unsupported Tools.handlePosition implementation. The earlier single-selection correction remains valid. The task stayed InProgress pending a real EditorTool-based solution if the built-in transform handle remained wrong.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 5 USER REPRO. User supplied Inspector/SceneView captures showing distinct bone local transforms and correct custom overlay bone positions, while the built-in Rotate handle remained visually anchored at the wrong point. Euler Inspector edits deform more plausibly, but generated Body skinning still shows stretching/smearing. This separates the editor handle issue from the skin-weight/deformation issue.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 5 IMPLEMENTATION. Added `RigBoneRotateTool`, a Unity 6 EditorTool that uses `Handles.RotationHandle` at the selected rig bone's world Transform.position, respects local/global handle orientation, records Undo, and is only available for a single generated CreatureRig bone. This avoids the unsupported Tools.handlePosition setter entirely.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 5 ADVERSARIAL PEER REVIEW. Verified against current Unity 6 API: EditorTool/OnToolGUI and Handles.RotationHandle are supported; Tools.handlePosition is read-only. The tool is global but gated by IsAvailable to a selected generated rig bone and does not modify PivotMode. Remaining validation is interaction-level Unity verification. Separately created TSK-0167 for the observed implicit-body skinning smear so the editor-pivot bug is not conflated with deformation weighting.
